title: House of bees
content: The title is a play on a book I once read called “House of leaves” IYKYK… Anyway, my dream was very similar in the sense that the house kept changing. I was in this house, and every time I went outside to the back yard, I got attacked by bees. I had to go back inside to avoid getting stung. Each time I went inside the layout slightly changed, and the house was larger. Whenever I found a new exit or entrance, I would try to escape and the bees swarm again. each time I came back in the house, it was larger and the layout had changed. I eventually found a door that led to a parking garage and while I was in the parking garage, I was safe for the most part. However, if I tried to go into the open, the bees would swarm. After exploring the parking garage, I stumbled on an alleyway that led me to some sort of Chinatown market with bright red and gold colors and there was a random lottery game that you played with Mahjong tiles. If you matched the tiles with the screen, you were given fried chicken bites with dipping sauces as a prize. As long as I stayed in this bizarre market, I was fine, but if I went back to the parking garage and back to the house and tried to go outside, the bees would come back. It was just so weird and reminded me of the changing space in house of leaves. Anyway… has anyone else experienced a Chinatown like market in their mallworld?
